title: \(p\)-adic geometry notes
text:
My purpose is to write some informal, intuition-first notes on topics related to \(p\)-adic geometry.
Even so, there may be some proofs of results that interest me.
The aim is not to replace a textbook, but to record my study experiences in \(p\)-adic geometry.

title: \(p\)-adic geometry notes
text:
Notes


Étale Morphisms
The aim for this note is to figure out lots of equivalent definitions of étale morphisms and give some intuitions.

More notes will live here

NoteStatus



This is a living notebook. Explanations may be heuristic, abbreviated, or revised as the surrounding picture becomes clearer. Also, some parts may simply be forgotten by the author, who is a lazy man.

title: Definitions and Intuitions
text:
A morphism \(f\colon X\to Y\) between schemes is étale if it is

locally of finite presentation,
flat, and
unramified.







TipIntuition



We could think of an étale map as a map that is locally an isomorphism. It can be rigorously proven for varieties.

title: Definitions and Intuitions
text:
Example: an open immersion
Every open immersion (UX) is étale. Nothing changes near a point of (U): we have only restricted our attention to a smaller open set.

title: Definitions and Intuitions
text:
Example: the power map
Assume that (n) is invertible in the base field. On the punctured affine line, the map
\[
\mathbb G_m \longrightarrow \mathbb G_m, \qquad t\longmapsto t^n
\]
is étale. Infinitesimally its derivative is (nt^{n-1}), which never vanishes on (G_m).






WarningWhere the picture breaks



On the whole affine line, (tt^n) ramifies at (t=0). The map is no longer étale there: the branches collide.

title: Definitions and Intuitions
text:
What to remember

Open immersions are the simplest étale maps.
Étale maps may have several sheets, but they have no infinitesimal branching.

title: How to edit these notes
text: 你平时主要需要编辑扩展名为 .qmd 的文件。它和 Markdown 几乎一样，但对数学公式、目录和提示框支持得更好。

title: How to edit these notes
text:
修改一篇笔记
在 VS Code 左侧文件列表中打开对应的 .qmd 文件，直接修改文字并保存即可：
## A new section

普通文字写在这里，行内公式写成 $X \to Y$。

$$
\Omega_{X/Y}=0
$$
以 --- 包围的文件开头是页面信息。通常只需要修改其中的 title 和 subtitle。

title: How to edit these notes
text:
删除一篇笔记

删除对应的 .qmd 文件。
打开项目根目录的 _quarto.yml。
在 sidebar 的 contents 中删掉指向该文件的两行，例如：

- href: "etale morphism/definitions-and-intuitions.qmd"
  text: Definitions and Intuitions
如果只删除文件而不修改 _quarto.yml，网站构建时会提示找不到页面。

title: How to edit these notes
text:
新增一篇笔记
最简单的方法是复制一篇现有的 .qmd 文件，改名并修改内容，然后在 _quarto.yml 的对应章节加入：
- href: "etale morphism/examples.qmd"
  text: Examples
以后添加新的大主题时，可以新建一个文件夹，再在 _quarto.yml 中增加一个 section。文件夹名称最好使用小写英文和连字符，例如 perfectoid-spaces。






Tip最省事的工作方式



你也可以只负责写内容，然后告诉我“把这篇笔记放到某个章节并发布”。目录、链接、渲染和推送都可以交给我处理。

title: How to edit these notes
text:
本地预览
在英文路径的工作目录 C:\notes\p-adic-geometry-note 中打开 VS Code，然后在终端运行：
.\preview-local.ps1
终端会显示一个 http://localhost:... 地址。保持这个终端运行，保存 .qmd 文件后网页会自动刷新；结束预览时按 Ctrl+C。

title: Étale Morphisms
text:
Étale morphisms are the algebro-geometric analogue of local isomorphisms. They preserve local dimension, introduce no infinitesimal ramification, and often behave like covering maps (especially for finite étale morphisms).
For a first pass, continue to Definitions and Intuitions.
